must_fire.what: target es5 is a hard error in TS 7
baseUrl: src with no paths; imports rely on it
bare import 'utils/format' resolves only via baseUrl
imports ts-morph (JS compiler API consumer); needs the alias scheme
ts-morph depends on the TypeScript JS API
typescript-eslint breaks on TS 7 (blocks lint); alias scheme or move lint
dev script runs ts-node; replace with tsx
NODE_OPTIONS contains --v8-pool-size=4, which breaks native-compiler worker threads; keep --max-old-space-size

must_not_fire.why: outDir is not a removed option
typescript itself is the compiler, not a JS-API consumer

notes: typescript 5.9.3 (authoritative.kind js). Typecheck, vitest and eslint (typescript-eslint 8.72.0, flat config eslint.config.mjs) all pass at baseline.

outDir (tsconfig.json:14) without rootDir is a possible tc-03 (rootDir default change) exposure; it is a fit-probe diagnostic delta, so it is not pinned as must_fire.
